[[Image:Rut'theran Village.jpg|thumb|Rut'theran Village]]
'''Rut'theran Village''' is an outpost port for the [[night elf]] [[city]] of [[Darnassus]], situated at the very bottom of the great tree [[Teldrassil]]. There is a portal here that goes directly into [[Darnassus]], and a pier for a docking [[boat]] to [[Auberdine]] in [[Darkshore]]. There is also a [[hippogryph]] roost that both go for free to [[Auberdine]], and for [[druid]]s, from [[Moonglade]] in northern [[Kalimdor]].
